title: Cushman & Wakefield Welcomes Back Melissa Lofing to Strengthen Valuation for Financial Reporting Practice
summary: Cushman & Wakefield Welcomes Back Melissa Lofing to Strengthen Valuation for Financial Reporting Practice
body_markdown:
Melissa Lofing


[NEW YORK](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/offices/new-york) – Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE: CWK), a leading global commercial real estate services firm, today announced that Melissa Lofing, MAI, has rejoined the firm's Valuation & Advisory (V&A) business in a leadership role within its Valuation for Financial Reporting practice.


“We've had the pleasure of working with Melissa before and know firsthand the depth of experience she brings to financial reporting valuation," said[Michele Kauffman](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/people/michele-kauffman) , Chief Growth Officer, Valuation & Advisory at Cushman & Wakefield. "Her deep technical knowledge, established industry relationships and experience leading financial reporting valuation practices will further strengthen our ability to deliver sophisticated solutions for clients and support the continued growth of this important business."


Lofing brings extensive experience advising institutional investors, corporations, REITs and professional advisors on complex real estate valuation matters involving financial reporting, transactions and regulatory requirements. Her return further strengthens Cushman & Wakefield's specialized valuation capabilities and its ability to support clients navigating increasingly complex financial reporting needs.


Her expertise spans fair value measurement, purchase price allocations, business combinations, net asset valuation, impairment analysis and lease accounting under U.S. GAAP and IFRS. She has advised clients across a broad range of industries and property sectors.


In her role, Lofing will contribute to the continued growth of Cushman & Wakefield's Valuation for Financial Reporting practice, working alongside valuation specialists, sector experts and client relationship teams to deliver solutions across real estate portfolios and complex transactions.


“It's great to be coming back to Cushman & Wakefield," said Lofing. "Having spent much of my career advising clients on complex financial reporting matters, I see a significant opportunity to build on the strength of the firm's platform and deliver thoughtful solutions that help clients navigate increasingly complex valuation and accounting requirements. I'm looking forward to reconnecting with colleagues and building new relationships across the business."


Lofing previously served as a Managing Director and National Co-Leader of Cushman & Wakefield's Financial Reporting practice. Most recently, she co-led the Financial Reporting practice at Apprise by Walker & Dunlop. Earlier in her career, she spent approximately 15 years at KPMG, where she held senior valuation leadership responsibilities in the United States and Australia.
